title: Release one paper proof envelope
provenance: Fictional training; not live guidance; no step executed.
intent: Help the print-room volunteer follow the mandatory supplied order for one paper proof envelope, not a production print run. No alternate route is supplied.

items.label: Copy the job identifier from the blue job card onto the envelope
detail: Copy it exactly; do not substitute the client's name. No actual identifier is supplied in this fictional packet.

items.label: Count the enclosed proof sheets and write the count on that same envelope
detail: Count blank sheets as well as printed ones. No expected sheet count is supplied.

items.label: Obtain the supervisor's initials in the release box on the blue job card
detail: Initials in the comments box do not constitute release permission. The packet does not say approval has been granted.

items.label: Only after the release-box initials are present, place the envelope in the collection tray
detail: Do not place it there before that permission is recorded. The collection tray is inside the print room, not the public counter.

items.label: Enter the actual placement time in the paper handover log, using local 24-hour time
detail: This log entry reports placement in the tray, not client collection. No placement time or client collection time is supplied; do not invent either.
